statement: The function returns a result r. If there exists a sequence s of length numCourses that is a permutation of {0, 1, ..., numCourses-1} and for every i with 0 <= i < len(prerequisites), if prerequisites[i][0] = a and prerequisites[i][1] = b, then the index of b in s is less than the index of a in s, then r is such a sequence. preconditions: numCourses is an integer with 1 <= numCourses <= 2000. prerequisites is a slice of vectors, each of length 2. For every i with 0 <= i < len(prerequisites), let a = prerequisites[i][0] and b = prerequisites[i][1]; then 0 <= a, b < numCourses and a != b. All pairs [a, b] are distinct.
